A few things to know

Before you
press play.

Are these stories created with AI?

SeryaPlay is being built for drama series created using AI tools. This preview introduces fictional series concepts with original AI-generated cover artwork. Finished episodes are not available yet.

Can I watch on my phone?

The website is designed for phones, tablets, and computers. You can already browse the preview collection and save your favorites on this device. Video playback will be available when episodes launch.

What will the membership include?

The planned offer is ₱150 per month for full access to all published series, with a 3-day free trial. Membership and billing are coming at launch. This preview does not create a paid account or collect payment.
